Jules Harper (CS): Dropping Sentinel onboarding notes + raw asks. Putting here so PM/Product can triage.
Rohan Mehta (PM): Paste raw bullets, thx.
Jules Harper (CS): Raw notes from call:
- Request: tenant-level model pin + "freeze" toggle in Console. Compliance needs to lock model during audits.
- Request: downloadable per-route billing CSV with cost_cents and token_count per request window.
- Request: lightweight quantization guidance in Console (recommendation + expected latency/cost delta).
- Pain: sporadic cold-start latency for dev-tenants (~250-700ms TTFB).
- Pain: private deployment logs drop X-User-ID when routed through their Istio sidecar.
- Ask: 30-min SRE enablement session + one-pager for procurement.
Yuna Kim (Eng): Quick tech notes: model pin = routing metadata + version pinning; UI ~2w, backend ~1w. Billing CSV = exporter change + new endpoint ~3 dev-days. Quant guide = research spike 1w + UI 1w. Cold-starts: warm-worker pool pilot ~5 dev-days. Istio header passthrough likely config-only but need sample config.
Olivia Park (Product): From customer tone: billing CSV and model-freeze are blockers for renewal. Quant guide is nice-to-have. Enablement one-pager helpful for procurement.
Rohan Mehta (PM): Proposed prioritization:
- P0: Billing CSV + per-route labels -> owner: Rohan Mehta -> ETA: 10 business days -> reason: procurement/renewal
- P0: Tenant model-freeze toggle -> owner: Olivia Park -> ETA: 3 weeks -> reason: compliance
- P1: Istio header passthrough spec -> owner: Jules Harper -> ETA: 3 business days to spec -> then eng backlog
- P1: Warm-worker pilot for dev-tenants -> owner: Yuna Kim -> ETA: 2 week pilot -> reason: reduce TTFB tails
- P2: Quantization guidance feature -> owner: TBD -> ETA: research first
ticket-bot: Created ticket SNT-9001: "Sentinel 6 billing export + model-freeze" assigned to Rohan Mehta due in 10 business days.
Jules Harper (CS): Please add acceptance criteria: CSV columns = utc_date, tenant_id, route, token_count, cost_cents, currency, notes. Timezone = UTC.
Yuna Kim (Eng): Will need sample traces and their Istio Envoy config to validate header passthrough.
Rohan Mehta (PM): Adding smoke-test prompt set requirement to SNT-9001 (8 prompts: short, long, structured, edge-case).
Olivia Park (Product): Ill mock Console freeze flow + RBAC options and attach designs to SNT-9002 (model-freeze). ETA Fri EOD.
Jules Harper (CS): Uploading recording + sample CSV from the customer to /customers/sentinel/onboard and scheduling enablement for next Wed 11am.
Yuna Kim (Eng): Starting warm-worker scoping tomorrow, will post estimated cost impact and runbook.
Rohan Mehta (PM): I'll draft a 1-page procurement blurb and attach to the ticket.
Jules Harper (CS): Thanks team. Will follow up after PRD lands. :thumbsup:
Olivia Park (Product): :rocket:
